name: StanceTheme
summary: Applies the Stance theme and bridges it into Material 3, with light, dark, high contrast and system modes.
accessibility: System mode follows the device dark theme and contrast settings.
Reduced motion follows the system animation setting.

name: StanceSurface
summary: A themed container with token elevation that becomes a solid outline in high contrast.
accessibility: Clickable surfaces get button semantics and ripple.

name: StanceCard
summary: Groups related content in outline, elevated or filled styles, optionally as one clickable target.
accessibility: A clickable card is one action for screen readers.

name: StanceDivider
summary: A thin horizontal or vertical line that separates content.
accessibility: Decorative, so it is not announced.

name: StanceScaffold
summary: The page frame: edge to edge on the canvas colour, with insets and an optional snackbar host.
accessibility: Content receives system bar, cutout and keyboard insets as padding.

name: StanceAdaptiveGrid
summary: A lazy grid that fits as many columns as the window allows on phones, tablets and foldables.
accessibility: Reading order follows the grid from start to end.

name: StanceIcon
summary: Draws one of the 99 Stance icons, tinted with the current content colour.
accessibility: Pass null as the description for decorative icons.

name: stanceFocusRing
summary: A modifier that draws the Stance focus ring while an element has keyboard or D-pad focus.
accessibility: The ring is 2dp, or 3dp in high contrast.

name: StanceButton
summary: Triggers an action, with six variants, three sizes, icons and a loading state.
accessibility: Touch target is at least 48dp.
Loading keeps focus and is announced as Loading.

name: StanceIconButton
summary: An icon-only button in ghost, outline or filled styles that requires an accessible name.
example: StanceIconButton(StanceIcons.Trash, contentDescription = "Delete template", onClick = {})
accessibility: Touch target is at least 48dp.
The content description is required.

name: StanceFloatingActionButton
summary: The primary action of a screen, as an icon or an extended button with a label.
example: StanceFloatingActionButton(StanceIcons.Plus, contentDescription = "New template", onClick = {}, text = "New template")
accessibility: Icon-only buttons are named by their content description.

name: StanceButtonGroup
summary: Connected segments for choosing one of a few options.
example:
var selected by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
StanceButtonGroup(listOf("Day", "Week", "Month"), selected, onSelect = { selected = it })
accessibility: Announced as a radio group with the selected segment.

name: StanceSplitButton
summary: A primary action paired with a menu of related actions.
example:
StanceSplitButton(
    text = "Save",
    onClick = {},
    menuItems = listOf(StanceMenuItem("Save as draft", onClick = {}), StanceMenuItem("Save and deploy", onClick = {})),
    menuDescription = "More save options",
)
accessibility: The menu button has its own accessible name.

name: StanceDropdownMenu
summary: A menu of actions with icons, groups, disabled and destructive items.
accessibility: Dismisses on back, outside taps and Escape.

name: StanceFormField
summary: Lays out a label, a control, helper text and an announced error message.
accessibility: Errors are a polite live region and include an icon.
The required marker is read as required.

name: StanceTextField
summary: A text input with a label above it, helper text, error state, prefix and suffix.
example:
var name by remember { mutableStateOf("Sales team signature") }
StanceTextField(name, { name = it }, label = "Template name", helper = "Visible to your organisation.", required = true)
accessibility: The label is the accessible name.
An error marks the field invalid and is announced.

name: StancePasswordField
summary: A password input with a button to show or hide the value.
example:
var password by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
StancePasswordField(password, { password = it }, label = "Password")
accessibility: The toggle is named Show password or Hide password.

name: StanceSearchBar
summary: A search field with a clear button and a search keyboard action.
example:
var query by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
StanceSearchBar(query, { query = it }, placeholder = "Search templates")
accessibility: The clear button has an accessible name.

name: StanceCheckbox
summary: A checkbox with a label and description, including an indeterminate state.
example:
var checked by remember { mutableStateOf(true) }
StanceCheckbox("Send me a copy", checked, { checked = it }, description = "A PDF is emailed after signing.")
accessibility: Touch target is at least 48dp.
The row is one toggle announced with its label and state.

name: StanceRadioGroup
summary: A labelled set of mutually exclusive options with optional descriptions.
example:
var role by remember { mutableStateOf("editor") }
StanceRadioGroup(
    label = "Role",
    options = listOf(StanceRadioOption("viewer", "Viewer"), StanceRadioOption("editor", "Editor", "Can change templates")),
    selected = role,
    onSelect = { role = it },
)
accessibility: Touch target is at least 48dp.
Announced as a group, with each option as a radio button.

name: StanceSwitch
summary: A switch with its label for settings that apply immediately.
example:
var enabled by remember { mutableStateOf(true) }
StanceSwitch("Apply to new members automatically", enabled, { enabled = it })
accessibility: Touch target is at least 48dp.
Announced as a switch with On or Off.

name: StanceSlider
summary: Picks a number from a range, with a visible label and value.
example:
var value by remember { mutableFloatStateOf(40f) }
StanceSlider("Rollout", value, { value = it }, valueRange = 0f..100f, valueText = "${value.toInt()}%")
accessibility: Adjustable with arrow keys and accessibility actions.
The value text is announced.

name: StanceRangeSlider
summary: Picks a lower and an upper bound from a range using two thumbs.
example:
var range by remember { mutableStateOf(20f..80f) }
StanceRangeSlider("Team size", range, { range = it }, valueRange = 0f..100f, valueText = "${range.start.toInt()} to ${range.endInclusive.toInt()}")
accessibility: Each thumb is separately focusable and adjustable.

name: StanceSelect
summary: Chooses one value from a list using the platform exposed dropdown menu.
example:
var role by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>("admin") }
StanceSelect(
    label = "Role",
    options = listOf(StanceSelectOption("admin", "Administrator"), StanceSelectOption("member", "Member")),
    selected = role,
    onSelect = { role = it },
)
accessibility: The field is named by its label and announces the selected value.

name: StanceDatePicker
summary: A date field that opens the Material date picker in a dialog.
example:
var date by remember { mutableStateOf<Long?>(null) }
StanceDatePicker("Signing deadline", date, onDateSelected = { date = it })
accessibility: Uses the platform picker, including its keyboard input mode.

name: StanceDateRangePicker
summary: A field for a start and end date using the Material range picker.
accessibility: Uses the platform picker semantics.

name: StanceTimePicker
summary: A time field that opens the Material time picker, in 12 or 24 hour format.
example:
var time by remember { mutableStateOf<Pair<Int, Int>?>(9 to 30) }
StanceTimePicker("Reminder", time?.first, time?.second, onTimeSelected = { h, m -> time = h to m })
accessibility: Uses the platform picker semantics.

name: StanceFilterChip
summary: A chip that toggles a filter and shows a check when selected.
example:
var selected by remember { mutableStateOf(true) }
StanceFilterChip("Signed", selected, onClick = { selected = !selected })
accessibility: Announced with its selected state.

name: StanceInputChip
summary: A removable chip for something a person entered, such as a recipient.
example: StanceInputChip("Priya Nair", onRemove = {}, removeDescription = "Remove Priya Nair")
accessibility: The remove action has a descriptive label.

name: StanceNavigationBar
summary: Bottom navigation for three to five destinations on compact screens.
example:
var selected by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
StanceNavigationBar(destinations, selected, onSelect = { selected = it })
accessibility: Touch target is at least 48dp.
The selected destination is announced.

name: StanceNavigationRail
summary: Side navigation for medium-width windows such as tablets in portrait.
example:
var selected by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
StanceNavigationRail(destinations, selected, onSelect = { selected = it }, modifier = Modifier.height(StanceSpacing.space24 * 3))
accessibility: The selected destination is announced.

name: StanceNavigationDrawer
summary: A permanent navigation drawer for expanded windows.
accessibility: The selected item is filled and announced as selected.

name: StanceAdaptiveNavigation
summary: Navigation that switches between bar, rail and drawer by window width.
accessibility: Order and selection are kept across layouts.

name: StanceTopAppBar
summary: The bar at the top of a screen with a title, navigation and actions.
accessibility: The title is a heading.
The back button has an accessible name.

name: StanceTabs
summary: Switches between views of the same context, fixed or scrollable.
example:
var selected by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
StanceTabs(listOf("Details", "Rollout", "History"), selected, onSelect = { selected = it })
accessibility: Tabs are announced with their selected state.

name: StancePagerIndicator
summary: Dots that show the current page of a horizontal pager.
example: StancePagerIndicator(pageCount = 4, currentPage = 1)
accessibility: Announced once as Page x of y.

name: StanceStepper
summary: Shows progress through a multi-step flow with complete, current, upcoming and error states.
example: StanceStepper(listOf("Template", "Recipients", "Review", "Deploy"), currentStep = 1)
accessibility: Each step is announced with its position and state.

name: StanceListItem
summary: A list row with leading content, headline, supporting text and trailing content.
example:
StanceListItem(
    headline = "Sales team signature",
    supporting = "Deployed to 48 users",
    leading = { StanceAvatar("Sales Team") },
    trailing = { StanceBadge("Live", tone = StanceTone.Success) },
    onClick = {},
)
accessibility: Touch target is at least 48dp.
A clickable row is one button.

name: StanceBadge
summary: A short status label in soft, solid or outline styles with five tones.
accessibility: Status is carried by the text, not only colour.

name: StanceTag
summary: A compact keyword or category label with an optional icon.
example: StanceTag("Legal", icon = StanceIcons.Tag)
accessibility: Read as plain text.

name: StanceAvatar
summary: Represents a person with their initials or an image, in three sizes.
example: StanceAvatar("Amara Okafor")
accessibility: Announced by the person’s name.

name: StanceAvatarGroup
summary: A stack of overlapping avatars with a counter for the rest.
example: StanceAvatarGroup(listOf("Amara Okafor", "Lukas Brenner", "Priya Nair", "Hana Sato", "Owen Price"), max = 3)
accessibility: Announced as one summary of names.

name: StanceProgressIndicator
summary: Linear progress with a label and percentage, determinate or indeterminate.
example: StanceProgressIndicator(0.72f, label = "Rollout")
accessibility: Announced with its label and percentage.

name: StanceCircularProgressIndicator
summary: Circular progress for loading states, determinate or indeterminate.
example: StanceCircularProgressIndicator(contentDescription = "Loading templates")
accessibility: Requires a description of what is loading.

name: StanceSkeleton
summary: A pulsing placeholder shown in place of content while it loads.
accessibility: Hidden from screen readers.
The pulse stops when animations are off.

name: StanceEmptyState
summary: Explains an empty screen or list and offers the next step.
accessibility: The title is a heading.

name: StanceTimeline
summary: A vertical sequence of events with times and status tones.
accessibility: Each event is read as one item.

name: StanceStatCard
summary: A key figure with its label, an icon and the change since last period.
example: StanceStatCard("Signatures deployed", "1,284", change = "12%", changeDescription = "up 12% from last month", positive = true)
accessibility: The change is spoken in words.

name: StanceDescriptionList
summary: Pairs of terms and details, such as the properties of a contract.
example: StanceDescriptionList(listOf("Owner" to "Priya Nair", "Status" to "Live", "Users" to "48"))
accessibility: Each pair is read together.

name: StanceDataTable
summary: A simple table that scrolls horizontally when columns do not fit.
example:
data class User(val name: String, val team: String, val deployments: Int)
StanceDataTable(
    columns = listOf(
        StanceTableColumn<User>("Name") { it.name },
        StanceTableColumn("Team") { it.team },
        StanceTableColumn("Deployments", numeric = true) { it.deployments.toString() },
    ),
    rows = listOf(User("Priya Nair", "Sales", 14), User("Hana Sato", "Finance", 9)),
    caption = "Organisation users",
)
accessibility: Headers are headings.
Rows are read as header and value pairs.

name: StanceSnackbarHost
summary: Shows brief messages about completed actions, with tones and an action.
accessibility: Messages are announced as they appear.

name: StanceDialog
summary: A dialog for a focused task with custom content and actions.
accessibility: The title is a heading.
Dismisses on back and outside taps.

name: StanceAlertDialog
summary: Asks for a decision, with a danger style and loading state for destructive actions.
accessibility: Uses the platform alert dialog semantics.

name: StanceBottomSheet
summary: A modal bottom sheet for secondary tasks, with a drag handle and title.
accessibility: Supports drag, back and scrim taps to dismiss.

name: StanceTooltip
summary: A short hint shown on long press, hover or keyboard focus.
accessibility: Supplementary only, never essential information.

name: StanceInlineAlert
summary: A status message placed inside the content it relates to.
example: StanceInlineAlert("13 mailboxes could not be updated.", tone = StanceTone.Warning, title = "Deployment incomplete")
accessibility: Warnings and errors are announced immediately.

name: StanceBanner
summary: A page-level announcement across the top of a screen.
example: StanceBanner("Scheduled maintenance on Saturday from 22:00.", tone = StanceTone.Info, onDismiss = {})
accessibility: Announced as a live region.
The dismiss button has a name.

name: StanceLoadingOverlay
summary: Covers content with a scrim and progress indicator while work is in progress.
accessibility: The message is announced and taps are blocked.

name: StanceErrorState
summary: Explains that something failed and offers a retry action.
example: StanceErrorState("Templates could not load", description = "Check your connection and try again.", onRetry = {}, modifier = Modifier.height(StanceSpacing.space24 * 3))
accessibility: The title is a heading.

name: StancePullToRefresh
summary: Wraps scrollable content with the platform pull-to-refresh gesture.
accessibility: Offer a refresh action for people who cannot use the gesture.

name: StanceSwipeActions
summary: Reveals an action such as delete or archive when a row is swiped.
accessibility: The same actions are exposed as accessibility custom actions.

name: StanceSearchableList
summary: A search field over a filtered list with a result count and empty state.
example:
val people = listOf("Amara Okafor", "Lukas Brenner", "Priya Nair")
StanceSearchableList(
    items = people,
    matches = { person, query -> person.contains(query, ignoreCase = true) },
    placeholder = "Search users",
    modifier = Modifier.height(StanceSpacing.space24 * 3),
) { person ->
    StanceListItem(person, leading = { StanceAvatar(person) })
}
accessibility: The result count is announced as people type.

name: StanceFilterBar
summary: A scrolling row of filter chips with a clear-all action.
accessibility: Each chip announces its selected state.

name: StanceSignatureCanvas
summary: An area for drawing a signature with undo, clear and image export.
example:
val signature = rememberStanceSignatureState()
StanceSignatureCanvas(signature, label = "Signature")
accessibility: Announces whether it is signed.
Offer a typed or uploaded alternative.

name: rememberStancePhotoPicker
summary: Launches the system Photo Picker for one or more images, with no storage permission.
example:
val picker = rememberStancePhotoPicker { uris -> println("Picked ${uris.size} image") }
StanceButton("Choose logo", onClick = { picker.launch() }, variant = StanceButtonVariant.Outline, leadingIcon = StanceIcons.Image)
accessibility: Uses the accessible system picker.

name: rememberStanceDocumentPicker
summary: Launches the system file picker for attaching documents.
example:
val picker = rememberStanceDocumentPicker(arrayOf("application/pdf")) { uris -> println("Picked ${uris.size} file") }
StanceButton("Attach PDF", onClick = { picker.launch() }, variant = StanceButtonVariant.Outline, leadingIcon = StanceIcons.Upload)
accessibility: Uses the accessible system picker.

name: StanceButtonView
summary: A Stance button usable from XML layouts and View code.
example:
// In a View-based screen, use StanceButtonView in XML or code.
AndroidView(factory = { context -> StanceButtonView(context).apply { text = "Save template" } })
accessibility: Keeps the same semantics as StanceButton.

name: setStanceContent
summary: Hosts Stance content inside an existing View hierarchy.
accessibility: Composed content keeps its semantics inside Views.

name: StanceThread
summary: The scrolling container for a conversation. Follows the newest message only while the reader is at the bottom.
accessibility: A list named by its label.
New responses are announced once, when complete.

name: StanceMessage
summary: One turn in a conversation from the user, the assistant or the system, as a bubble or plain.
accessibility: The author and time are a heading.
Status is read as the heading state while a response arrives.
Message actions are screen reader custom actions.

name: StanceMessageGroup
summary: Consecutive messages from one author under a single avatar and name.
accessibility: The author row is a heading.

name: StanceMessageActions
summary: The row of actions under a message: copy, retry, edit, good response and bad response.
example:
var rating by remember { mutableStateOf<StanceRating?>(null) }
StanceMessageActions(onCopy = { println("Copied") }, onRetry = { println("Retry") }, onRate = { rating = it }, rating = rating)
accessibility: Touch target is at least 48dp.
Rating buttons are toggles.
Copy confirms with a polite announcement.

name: StanceBranchSwitcher
summary: Steps between alternative versions of a message after an edit or retry.
example:
var index by remember { mutableIntStateOf(1) }
StanceBranchSwitcher(count = 3, index = index, onIndexChange = { index = it })
accessibility: Touch target is at least 48dp.
The position, for example 2 of 3, is a polite live region.
Arrows mirror in right to left layouts.

name: StanceScrollToLatest
summary: A floating button that appears when the reader has scrolled away from the newest message.
example: StanceScrollToLatest(visible = true, onClick = { println("Scroll to latest") }, unreadCount = 2)
accessibility: Touch target is at least 48dp.
The name includes the number of new messages.

name: StanceConversationList
summary: A list of past conversations grouped by date, with selection, rename, delete and pin.
example:
var selected by remember { mutableStateOf("rollout") }
StanceConversationList(
    items = listOf(
        StanceConversation("rollout", "Signature rollout", updatedAt = "10:42", group = "Today"),
        StanceConversation("footer", "Legal footer wording", updatedAt = "Monday", group = "This week", pinned = true),
        StanceConversation("audit", "March audit summary", updatedAt = "Tuesday", group = "This week"),
    ),
    selectedId = selected,
    onSelect = { selected = it.id },
    onRename = { println("Rename ${it.title}") },
    onDelete = { println("Delete ${it.title}") },
    onPin = { item, pinned -> println("Pin ${item.title}: $pinned") },
    modifier = Modifier.height(StanceSizes.pickerMaxHeight / 2),
)
accessibility: Group names are headings.
The current conversation is announced as selected.
Row actions are also screen reader custom actions.

name: StanceThreadEmptyState
summary: The opening screen of a new conversation with a greeting and starter prompts.
example:
StanceThreadEmptyState(
    title = "How can I help?",
    description = "Ask about templates, rollouts and policies.",
    starters = listOf(
        StanceStarter("audit", "Summarise the last rollout", "Who received it and who did not", StanceIcons.BarChart),
        StanceStarter("footer", "Draft a legal footer", "Based on the brand policy", StanceIcons.FileText),
    ),
    onStarterSelect = { println("Starter ${it.id}") },
)
accessibility: The title is a heading.
Each starter is one button.

name: StancePromptComposer
summary: The message input: a text area that grows with content, with slots and a send button that becomes stop.
example:
var draft by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
var status by remember { mutableStateOf(StanceGenerationStatus.Idle) }
StancePromptComposer(
    value = draft,
    onValueChange = { draft = it },
    onSubmit = { status = StanceGenerationStatus.Streaming },
    onStop = { status = StanceGenerationStatus.Stopped },
    status = status,
    leading = { StanceIconButton(StanceIcons.Paperclip, "Attach a file", onClick = { println("Attach") }) },
    footer = { StanceDisclaimerNote("Answers can be wrong. Check important facts.", icon = null) },
)
accessibility: Touch target is at least 48dp.
Send is disabled when the draft is empty.
While a response arrives the same button is named Stop.

name: StanceAttachmentTray
summary: The attachments on a draft or a sent message, with progress, errors and remove.
example:
StanceAttachmentTray(
    items = listOf(
        StanceAttachment("policy", "Brand policy.pdf", sizeLabel = "1.2 MB"),
        StanceAttachment("logo", "Logo.png", kind = StanceAttachmentKind.Image, progress = 0.4f),
        StanceAttachment("scan", "Scan.tiff", kind = StanceAttachmentKind.Image, error = "Too large"),
    ),
    onRemove = { println("Remove ${it.name}") },
)
accessibility: Each remove button names its file.
Upload errors are announced.

name: StanceMentionPicker
summary: A filterable list that opens above the composer to reference files, people or tools.
accessibility: Does not take focus, so typing continues.
The active row is announced as selected.
Closes on back, Escape and outside taps.

name: StanceSlashCommandMenu
summary: A command list that opens above the composer when the draft starts with a slash.
accessibility: Same list behaviour as the mention picker.

name: StanceModelPicker
summary: Chooses the model for the next message, with a short description and capability badges.
example:
var model by remember { mutableStateOf("swift") }
StanceModelPicker(models = sampleModels, selectedId = model, onSelect = { model = it.id })
accessibility: Touch target is at least 48dp.
The sheet is a radio group with the chosen model selected.

name: StanceContextChips
summary: Shows what the assistant can see for this message, such as files or pages, each removable.
accessibility: Touch target is at least 48dp.
A removable chip is one button named Remove and its label.

name: StanceVoiceInputButton
summary: A microphone button with idle, listening and processing states and a level ring.
accessibility: Touch target is at least 48dp.
A toggle button whose state changes are announced.

name: StanceStopButton
summary: Stops a response that is being generated, as an icon or a labelled button.
accessibility: Touch target is at least 48dp.
Named Stop for screen readers.

name: StanceTokenBudgetMeter
summary: A compact meter of how much of the context or message limit is used, as a ring, bar or text.
accessibility: A progress value with value text.
Crossing the warning threshold or the limit is announced once.
The warning has an icon, not colour alone.

name: StanceStreamingText
summary: Reveals text as it arrives at a steady cadence with a caret, without moving lines already shown.
example:
var streaming by remember { mutableStateOf(true) }
StanceStreamingText(
    text = "Publish the template, then assign it to a group. Mailboxes pick it up within an hour.",
    streaming = streaming,
    onRevealEnd = { println("Reveal finished") },
)
StanceButton("Finish", onClick = { streaming = false }, variant = StanceButtonVariant.Ghost)
accessibility: Announced once when complete, never token by token.
Shows at once when animations are off.

name: StanceThinkingIndicator
summary: Shows that the assistant is working before any text arrives, with a label and elapsed time.
accessibility: A polite status.
A static mark with the label when animations are off.

name: StanceReasoningDisclosure
summary: A collapsible block for reasoning: open while thinking, collapsed to a summary when done.
accessibility: Touch target is at least 48dp.
A button that reports expanded or collapsed.
The summary reads, for example, Thought for 12 seconds.

name: StanceShimmerText
summary: Text with a slow light sweep for labels of work in progress, such as Searching the web.
example: StanceShimmerText("Searching the brand policy")
accessibility: Plain text to screen readers.
No sweep when animations are off.

name: StanceGenerationProgress
summary: Progress for longer generations such as images or documents, with a stage label and cancel.
example:
StanceGenerationProgress(
    label = "Creating rollout report",
    progress = 0.42f,
    stage = "Rendering page 2 of 5",
    onCancel = { println("Cancelled") },
)
accessibility: Announced with its label and percentage.
Stage changes are announced politely.

name: StanceStreamingSkeleton
summary: Placeholder lines, card or image for a response that has been requested and has not started.
example: StanceStreamingSkeleton(lines = 3)
accessibility: Read as one loading status.
The pulse stops when animations are off.

name: StanceInterruptedState
summary: Marks a response that was stopped or failed part way, with retry and continue.
example:
StanceInterruptedState(
    reason = StanceInterruptedReason.Network,
    description = "The answer stopped part way. Your draft is safe.",
    onRetry = { println("Retry") },
    onContinue = { println("Continue") },
)
accessibility: Errors and lost connections are alerts.
Stopped and limit are polite statuses.

name: StanceCitationChip
summary: A numbered marker that links a claim to its source and previews it in a bottom sheet.
accessibility: Touch target is at least 48dp.
A button named, for example, Source 2 and the title.
The preview is reachable by touch, keyboard and screen reader.

name: StanceSourceList
summary: The sources behind an answer, as a compact row of chips that expands to a full list.
example: StanceSourceList(sources = sampleSources, max = 2, onSourceOpen = { println("Open ${it.title}") })
accessibility: The title is a heading.
Each chip is named by its source title.

name: StanceSourcePreview
summary: A card for one source: site, title, snippet and a link to open it.
example: StanceSourcePreview(source = sampleSources[0], onOpen = { println("Open source") })
accessibility: The link is a button with a visible label.

name: StanceConfidenceBadge
summary: States how sure the system is in words with a distinct icon, never colour alone.
accessibility: Read as the label and its description together.

name: StanceAIGeneratedLabel
summary: Marks content as generated, assisted or edited by AI, with the sparkle icon and the model name.
accessibility: Read as one phrase.

name: StanceDisclaimerNote
summary: A quiet note under the composer or a response, such as a reminder to check important facts.
example: StanceDisclaimerNote("Answers can be wrong. Check important facts.")
accessibility: Read as plain text.

name: StanceFeedbackBar
summary: Thumbs up or down, followed by optional reasons and a comment, then a thank you.
accessibility: Touch target is at least 48dp.
Rating buttons are toggles.
Reasons are a labelled group.
The thank you is announced.

name: StanceReportDialog
summary: A bottom sheet to report a response with a category and details.
accessibility: The title is a heading.
Categories are a radio group.
Stays open and busy while the report is sent.

name: StanceSensitiveContentGate
summary: Hides content behind a notice until the reader chooses to see it.
accessibility: Hidden content is absent from the accessibility tree.
Focus moves to the content on reveal.
